newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Proton Manila unit to launch new models.
newsitem.headline: Proton Manila unit to launch new models.

text.p: Proton Pilipinas Corp (PPC), a local joint venture company of Malaysia's Perusahaan Otomobil Nasional Bhd, is launching three car models in the Philippines, PPC senior vice president Ernesto Tan said on Tuesday.
Tan told reporters that PPC had invested an additional 105 million pesos in capital expenditures to manufacture the latest car models by next month.
Proton is to manufacture 100 units of Ciaras and 60 to 150 units of Audi A4 and Audi A6 models every month.
The Ciaras will be marketed to the small car market and the Audi models to the luxury car market, Tan said.
Proton currently manufactures its own Proton Wira as well as European cars such as Volkswagen and Alfa Romeo.
